description: This file defines a Flutter ChangeNotifier controller `HomeController` that manages the state and data fetching for the home screen. It interacts with a `ContentRepository` to load the home feed and continue watching items, handles cache refresh events, and provides data to the UI components.

classes.name: HomeController
classes.description: A controller class extending ChangeNotifier to manage the state of the home screen, including loading content, managing cache updates, and providing data to the UI.

methods.name: loadHomeFeed
methods.description: Fetches the home feed data using the repository, updates state accordingly, and manages loading indicators.

methods.name: loadContinueWatching
methods.description: Loads recent watch history and associated content details for the continue watching section.

methods.name: onPlaybackProgressPersisted
methods.description: Refreshes the continue watching list after a playback progress update.

methods.name: refreshFromCache
methods.description: Triggers refetching of home feed and continue watching data to reflect cache updates.
